rows.mappingNote: New exact-kana なんとなく1599730:1 unexplained-reason/purpose article.
rows.sourceNote: Usually kana; explicitly teach 何となく without enlarging primary metadata. Separate unexplained reason from managing an obstacle with 何とか; do not make どうも or ぼんやり artificially disjoint.

rows.mappingNote: New exact-kana なんとも1188690:1,2 extreme-degree/negative-anything article.
rows.sourceNote: Degree and negative constructions kept separate. 何とも言えない may genuinely mean inability to say/judge; 何とも思わない and 何ともない do not invariably praise an extreme. Explain 何とも and preserve kana identity.

rows.mappingNote: New ナンバー1090860:1 number article, additionally teaching abbreviated license-plate sense2.
rows.sourceNote: English-derived noun; primary kana has no Han metadata. Do not transfer every English counting expression. Public issue/music/rank usages are not added to the pinned selected senses.

rows.mappingNote: New 南米 なんべい1460570:1 South-America article.
rows.sourceNote: Modifier/head on compound ナン+ベイ. 米 is America-related abbreviation, not rice. Historical 亜米利加 supported by complete アメリカ family; South America is not the southern United States.

rows.mappingNote: New 南北 なんぼく1460600:1 directional-axis article, with context-bound Korea abbreviation sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Opposite-pair on compound; learn voiced ぼく in whole word. English order need not match Japanese. Korea reference requires the relevant context; 東西 is a contrast, not a synonym.

rows.mappingNote: New 煮える にえる1322490:1 be-boiled/cooked article.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive ichidan, food が; contrast 煮る without treating える as a passive rule. Digital Daijisen explicitly supports liquid boiling too. Do not teach a water-boiling prohibition or merge boiling, rice cooking and baking methods.

rows.mappingNote: New 匂う におう1599780:1,2 smell/fragrance article, recognizing glow and hints additionally.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive godan endingう. Good-smell 匂う/bad-smell 臭う are usual spelling preferences, not absolute exclusions. Distinguish emitter from perceiver 嗅ぐ and adjective 臭いくさい; literary brightness and contextual suspicion remain bounded.

source.waller_definition: to let loose,to set free,to let escape

rows.mappingNote: New 逃がす にがす1450320:1 release article, additionally teaching missed capture/chance sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Transitive godan, target を. Can be deliberate release or failed capture; English let does not prove intent. Separate にがす/のがす written forms and escaping subject with 逃げる. Not a generic verb for every misplaced possession.

rows.mappingNote: New 憎い にくい1403390:1 hateful article, with admiring sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Existing 悪いわるい1151260 is not coverage merely because this family has alternate 悪いにくい. I-adjective and separately identified suffix2772730; no fixed intensity ranking with 憎らしい. Add reciprocal 憎 examples using にくい.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing 憎む にくむ1403440:1; add sourced N2 label only.
rows.sourceNote: Existing complete body already teaches exact transitive hatred use. No match in the four existing lower-level source TSVs for form/reading. Preserve body, title, readings, primary metadata and original exclusions; existing reciprocal 憎 pair remains complete.

rows.mappingNote: New 憎らしい にくらしい1403450:1 hateful article, with ironic darling sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Lexical i-adjective, not mechanically apparently hateful. Matching Digital Daijisen supports admiring use; positive tone is not guaranteed and no rigid intensity boundary with 憎い. Add reciprocal 憎 examples using にくらしい.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing kana にこにこ1091130:1; add sourced N2 label only.
rows.sourceNote: Raw source gloss remains empty. Existing full article already teaches friendly continuing smile, suru/to constructions and necessary contrasts. No lower-level source-index match; preserve identity, body, titles and exclusions.

rows.mappingNote: New 濁る にごる1415960:1,3 cloudy/impure article, additionally teaching dull sound/color and consonant voicing.
rows.sourceNote: Intransitive godanる; thing changing が, negative 濁らない. Turbidity, contamination, moral impurity and phonetic voicing distinguished; visible cloudiness does not prove harmful contamination. Primary 濁 metadata retained despite missing card.

rows.mappingNote: New 虹 にじ1463740:1 rainbow article.
rows.sourceNote: Single-kanji native noun. Rare 霓 recognized without changing primary spelling metadata. No fabricated 虹 card or inference from unrelated kanji readings, names or homophones.

rows.mappingNote: New 日時 にちじ1464110:1 appointment-date/time article, recognizing days/hours sense2.
rows.sourceNote: Additive on compound ニチ+ジ. Date/time versus elapsed time depends on context. Existing 時間 can also mean appointed time; do not teach duration-only prohibition or conflate 月日つきひ and がっぴ source identities.

rows.mappingNote: New 日用品 にちようひん1464910:1 daily-necessities article.
rows.sourceNote: 日用 modifies 品; on compound ニチ+ヨウ+ヒン with all three substantive component links. Includes durable everyday-use items, not just consumables. Broader goods/tool categories alone are not synonym guards.

rows.mappingNote: New 日課 にっか1463860:1 daily-routine/work/lesson article.
rows.sourceNote: Personal customary or assigned activity, not school-only. Explain nominalized activity+を日課にする. Whole compound にっか has smallっ; add 課 reading-row/Common words reciprocal example and footer ID without inventing constituent metadata reading.

rows.mappingNote: New 日程 にってい1464300:1 schedule/program/agenda article.
rows.sourceNote: On compound with smallっ; single-day/multiday programme and selected dates. Digital Daijisen explicitly supports selected-date use beyond pinned generic schedule wording. English agenda does not license every discussion-topic use; calendar object and activities distinguished.

rows.mappingNote: Reuse existing 鈍い にぶい1582430:1,2,4; add sourced N2 label only, preserving additional3,5 teaching.
rows.sourceNote: Existing complete body already teaches bluntness, critical obtuseness, dull sound/color, sluggishness and insensitive response. No easier source-index match. Preserve title, readings, exclusions and body; separate later のろい2838553 source row and existing reciprocal 鈍 pair.

rows.mappingNote: New 入社 にゅうしゃ1466260:1 joining-company article.
rows.sourceNote: Noun/intransitive suru, company に. Joining as employee, not daily office arrival. Compare company-scoped 就職 overlap against ongoing 勤める/働く and reporting 出勤; no blanket event/state or participant exemption substitutes for actual sense adjudication.

sourceAccessLimits: Completed actual author reads, not retrieval/preparation inferred as inspection. All nine original complete-family chunks and eleven original selected-older-body chunks were actually returned and read in the preceding segment, completing236 families/522 senses and89 full older bodies.

This segment actually read one supplemental family chunk (11 full families/29 senses), one supplemental older-body chunk (nine complete bodies), the complete schedule derivative (three full families/five senses) and complete individual カレンダー/ダイヤ/汚す bodies. The unique totals are250 families/556 senses and101 older bodies; no family overlaps across these captures.

All149 original navigation labels were read, not149 full bodies. Nine added labels come from the seven newly inspected degree/time bodies and two schedule bodies. Of the149 original candidate bodies,92 are inspected and57 remain unselected; the remaining nine inspected bodies were supplemental candidates.

The22 original/supplemental family-and-body rendering chunks are each at most16000UTF8 bytes. The separate schedule derivative was read completely. Preparation plans remain prepared_for_inspection; this completed-inspection record separately records actual returns.

All20 principal families/37 senses, all23 complete component records, all20 matching public lexical captures through EOF and complete 憎/課/鈍 bodies were read. Actual にぶい and 入社 public headings were selected after unrelated headings; modern 匂う is separate from historical lower-bigrade material.
Twenty Weblio captures are Digital Daijisen, one dictionary authority, not20 independent sources, fresh reviewer retrievals, frequency measurements or native-speaker certification.

Preserve the empty にこにこ source gloss. Existing unlevelled 憎む/にこにこ/鈍い already teach the requested identities; adding N2 only follows the exact no-match check in four lower-level TSV indexes. Their original full teaching, readings, titles, primary metadata and exclusions are unchanged.

Primary written Han remain in metadata even where 煮/匂/濁/虹 character cards do not exist. Kana primary identities do not inherit Han from body variants. Three new reciprocal pairs are added; existing 憎/憎む and鈍/鈍い already satisfy both backlink locations.

Quiz declarations are direct symmetric nontransitive author hypotheses, not independent verdicts. Full labels/bodies and ordinary secondary senses were considered. Category proximity, state/change and participant differences require actual sense adjudication, not automatic rules.
No exhaustive corpus-wide ambiguity audit, live-quiz uniqueness or global semantic cleanliness is claimed. Inherited batch61飛ぶ/飛行 and止まる/止む debt remains deferred.

quizGuardRationale: Judge each declared edge directly. Negative/extreme-degree functions of なんとも differ but both require comparisons, including ordinarily taught secondary intensifier uses.

憎い and憎らしい have ordinary ironic positive readings as well as hatred. Assess positive labels against those complete senses, not just default negative headlines; a neighboring guard never proves an additional edge.
日用品 and goods/tools share categories without automatic synonymy. 日課 has actual daily work/lesson/routine senses; broad work/task and habit labels require individual evaluation.
液体 can煮える according to the actual public modern heading; do not exempt boiling verbs by a false food-only rule. Cooking methods and Kansai-tagged broader 炊く still need bounded treatment.
Emitter/perceiver 匂う/嗅ぐ and state/change 濁る/鈍い need actual English/meaning checks, not blanket grammatical exemptions. Primary literal smell is not every figurative suspicion or brightness use.

逃げる escapee, escaped target with逃がす and company-employment event with入社 differ lexically, not merely by a rule excluding participants or states. Review whether actual title/ordinary sense overlap still warrants additional guards.

日程/日時/日付 scheduling can overlap without collapsing a printed calendar object, an itinerary, a date and a clock time into one lexical identity. カレンダー was inspected but is not automatically guarded by inheriting スケジュール's older list.
